source_locator.description: Muthan is freed by his friends, whispers a secret to them, is recaptured by hidden Vengaiyur soldiers and dragged to Velazhagan.

translation.english_text: [Muthan is in prison. His friends stealthily come and free him. He whispers a secret into their ears and leaves. Vengaiyur soldiers who have been watching from hiding spring on him and seize him, then immediately drag him to Velazhagan.]
